title: New Zealand Defence Force website breach, Nov 2026

subject.name: NZ Defence Force
subject.about: The New Zealand Defence Force (NZDF) is New Zealand's military: the Royal New Zealand Navy, the New Zealand Army and the Royal New Zealand Air Force. It is a government department that answers to the Minister of Defence.

disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by the New Zealand Defence Force, any news outlet, company, or anyone else named.
size_basis: One organisation's public websites and the database of one discount scheme for Defence Force families. The NZDF has not said how many people are in it, and nothing we read says its military systems were affected.
who_is_affected: People registered with the NZDF's Force4Families Defence Discounts scheme, whose names and email addresses were in the database; the NZDF says it has contacted them. Anyone looking for NZDF information online, since its website is offline.

known.text: The NZDF says its website provider told it on Nov 20 of unauthorised access to its website systems.
A database for the Force4Families discount scheme, holding names and email addresses, was accessed.
The NZDF website was still offline at our last check.
The NZDF has contacted people who may be affected and told the Privacy Commissioner.
